title: Session settings (frozen v0.1)
description: Chosen settings for one practice session. Status: FROZEN v0.1 (Phase 03, 2026-10-20) — the shape is fixed; only capability DATA may change later (Phase 08). Language ids must exist in packages/contracts/data/catalog.json at runtime (schema checks shape; catalog membership is a runtime check). Consent boundary: recording retention is consent to save AUDIO only. It never implies permission to durably keep transcripts, quoted mistakes, or model-generated report text — those stay transient under every setting here. Custom Topic is a transient learner-written field: it is never persisted, so the durable metrics shape rejects a `customTopic` property outright. Recording retention is OFF by default.

practiceLanguageId.description: Language the learner practices speaking, e.g. tamil.

coachingLanguageId.description: Language the coach explains in. Defaults to the practice language; the learner can choose another. No cross-language coaching pair has been validated.

scenarioId.description: Scenario preset id from the catalog, e.g. interview.

scenarioPresetId.description: A named preset under the chosen scenario, e.g. workplace-team-meeting. Null when the learner chose the scenario itself. Membership is a runtime check against the catalog.

customTopic.description: Optional transient learner-written topic. Present only for the `custom` scenario, and never persisted: the durable metrics shape rejects it by name.

coachingRoundTurns.description: Completed learner turns per coaching round. Plan default: 4. Counts conversational turns, never speech-to-text segments.

sessionLimitSeconds.description: Upper bound for one call, in seconds. Product cap: 10 minutes (600 s). The provider's realtime STT session cap is 900 s, so the product stays under it on purpose; a longer call needs a validated rollover design.

recordingRetention.description: Whether the learner opted in to saving the recording for replay. Default false. Audio only — never transcript retention.

languageId.description: Stable catalog id. Structure only: membership is verified at runtime against data/catalog.json, and 'french' being well-formed here does not make it a known language.

scenarioId.description: Stable catalog scenario id; membership verified at runtime.

customTopic.description: A learner-written topic, used only with the `custom` scenario. `persisted` is always false: the text is transient, is never written to durable metrics, logs or caches, and is never treated as an assessment of the learner.

consent.description: Versioned consent fields, captured at ingestion and re-checked at durable write time.

consentVersion.description: Version of the consent wording the learner saw. Stored with the consent record.

recordingRetentionGranted.description: True only if the learner explicitly allowed saving the recording for replay.

recordingRetentionGrantedAt.description: When the recording-retention permission was granted; null while no permission exists.
